answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its whisper recurs, its mesa survives audit, and a pigment from an unlinked peer confirms it.
